use_case_summary: Veridian needs a HIPAA-adjacent clinical chat assistant + document reranking for clinical notes. High QPS during clinic hours, low tolerance for tail latency. Prefer on-prem/VPC for PHI; SSO and audit trail required.
technical_notes: POC ran on dedicated nodes with 2 x A100-like GPUs. We tried: batching tweaks, KV prefix caching, lower-precision quantized variants. Improvements on average latency, but p95 remained ~1.7-2.1s for multi-turn streaming flows. Streaming jitter observed: chunk reordering and delayed final tokens impacting UX. Root causes suspected: model tokenization overhead on long contexts + kernel path for streaming not optimizing small increment flushes. Customer flagged inability to hit p95 SLA for conversational triage flows (target 600ms). Also asked for deterministic ordering guarantees for partial-stream responses which our current runtime can't promise without significant changes.
